cm.merch.lead: WBMC clothing and gear. Every product with photos, sizes, material, shipping and returns.
cm.merch.notFound: This product is no longer available.
cm.merch.emptyText: Club clothing and gear will appear here when ready. Until then, there are other ways to support the club.
cm.merch.how1t: Open a product, pick colour and size, read the material, shipping and returns details.
cm.merch.how2t: If a product has a “Buy” button, payment happens in a secure external shop. Otherwise send an order request by e-mail.
cm.merch.how3t: After your request the club replies with availability, the total and payment details.
cm.merch.noCard: No payments are taken on this website and no card details are entered or stored.
cm.pd.gallery: Product images — swipe or use the arrow keys
cm.pd.extNote: Payment happens in the secure {provider} shop. No card details are entered or stored on the WBMC website.
cm.pd.extNoteGeneric: Payment happens in an external shop. No card details are entered or stored on the WBMC website.
cm.pd.manualNote: No payments are taken on this website. The button opens your e-mail app with a prefilled request; the club will reply with availability, the total and payment details. Or write to
cm.pd.askRestock: Ask whether it will be available again
cm.pd.mFoot: I understand this is a request, not a paid order. The club will send payment details in its reply.
cm.pd.shippingDefault: The club states the delivery method, time and cost when replying to your order. Questions: wolvesmc@inbox.lv.
cm.pd.returnsDefault: The club states the return and exchange terms when replying to your order. Questions: wolvesmc@inbox.lv.
cm.partners.emptyTitle: The partner list is being put together
cm.partners.emptyText: Companies and organisations that work with WBMC and support the club will be listed here.
cm.partners.ctaText: Sponsorship, event support, product reviews or a long-term partnership — all options in one place.
cm.partners.consentNote: Partner brands and logos are published only with the partner's consent.
cm.ad.lead: Partnership formats for companies and organisations that want to be seen alongside WBMC — clearly labelled and agreed with the club.
cm.ad.formatsText: Tick what interests you — it will be included in your request e-mail automatically.
cm.ad.o1.title: Sponsored post
cm.ad.o1.text: A post about your company, product or event, prepared together with you.
cm.ad.o1.includes: Text and images, a link to your website; content agreed before publishing.
cm.ad.o1.where: On the WBMC website and, if agreed, the club's Facebook page.
cm.ad.o2.title: Category partner
cm.ad.o2.text: A partner in a specific field — for example service, gear, insurance or accommodation.
cm.ad.o2.includes: Logo, description and links on the partners page in your category; scope by agreement.
cm.ad.o2.where: On the “Partners” page and in the partner strip at the end of the home page.
cm.ad.o2.label: Partners section (logo only with your consent)
cm.ad.o3.title: Website banner
cm.ad.o3.text: An image banner with a link, in an agreed place and period.
cm.ad.o3.includes: One banner with a link; fixed start and end date.
cm.ad.o3.where: Home page, Motorcycle events, Ride HQ or Merch — by agreement.
cm.ad.o4.title: Event sponsor
cm.ad.o4.text: Support for a specific club event or ride.
cm.ad.o4.includes: Sponsor mention and logo in the event information; presence at the event by agreement.
cm.ad.o4.where: In the event description on the website and in event materials.
cm.ad.o4.label: “Sponsored” / event sponsor
cm.ad.o5.title: Product review
cm.ad.o5.text: Club members try a product or service and share their experience.
cm.ad.o5.includes: Review format, scope and timing by agreement.
cm.ad.o5.where: On the WBMC website and, if agreed, the club's Facebook page.
cm.ad.o6.title: Long-term partnership
cm.ad.o6.text: A season-long or yearly partnership combining several of these formats.
cm.ad.o6.includes: Combination of formats and period by agreement.
cm.ad.p1t: Tell us who you are and what kind of partnership you have in mind.
cm.ad.p2t: The club prepares an offer: format, period and price.
cm.ad.p3t: The club reviews and approves the offer and materials.
cm.ad.p4t: Materials go live for the agreed period, labelled “Sponsored”.
cm.ad.r1: The club reserves the right to refuse advertising that does not match the club's values.
cm.ad.r2: All advertising and sponsored content on the website is clearly labelled “Sponsored”.
cm.ad.r3: A partner's brand and logo are published only with the partner's consent.
cm.ad.r4: Packages and prices are approved by the club separately for each partnership.
cm.ad.r5: Audience data on request; we do not publish figures that are not backed by real analytics.
cm.ad.contactText: The button opens an e-mail with the formats you ticked. Add your company name, contact person and preferred period.
cm.ad.pickHint: No formats ticked — you can also describe your idea freely.
cm.sup.lead: Support the WBMC association and the club's work — by bank transfer, merch, partnership or helping at events.
cm.sup.whoText: Support goes to the club's registered association. The transfer recipient must be exactly this association.
cm.sup.useTitle: What the support is used for
cm.sup.useText: In the payment purpose you can state which area of the club's work you want to support.
cm.sup.generalText: The association uses the support where it is needed most at the time.
cm.sup.amountHint: If you enter an amount, it is included in the QR code. Without it, you enter the amount in your banking app.
cm.sup.amountErr: Enter the amount in euro, e.g. 20 or 20.50.
cm.sup.copyFail: Could not copy — select the text and copy it yourself.
cm.sup.qrText: Scan with your banking app (EPC / SEPA QR). Check the recipient and amount before confirming.
cm.sup.qrFail: Could not create the QR code — use the details above.
cm.sup.checkFirst: Before transferring, make sure the recipient is WBMC BIEDRĪBA and the IBAN matches. Questions:
cm.sup.confirmText: Your bank statement serves as confirmation of payment. If you need a confirmation issued by the association, write to wolvesmc@inbox.lv.
cm.sup.noOnline: No online payments are taken on this website and no card details are requested.
cm.sup.wayPartnerT: For companies — partnership, event support, advertising.
cm.sup.wayVolunteerT: Volunteering at club events and rides.
cm.sup.volunteerSubject: I want to help at WBMC events
cm.sup.contactText: About support, bank details or a payment confirmation, write to
cm.adm.merchText: Product catalogue. Only published products are public; their images become public only when published. No payments are taken on the site — add an external “Buy” link or leave it empty so buyers send a request by e-mail.
cm.adm.noProducts: No products yet. Add the first one — as a draft to start with.
cm.adm.name: Name
cm.adm.slugHint: Used in merch.html#p-… Empty — created from the name.
cm.adm.sortHint: Lower number — higher in the list.
cm.adm.featured: Show on the home page (up to 3 products)
cm.adm.priceHint: Only a price approved by the club. Empty — “Price to be confirmed”.
cm.adm.imagesHint: Up to 12 images. The first is the main one. Reorder by dragging or with ← →. Images are compressed before upload.
cm.adm.tooMany: You cannot add more than {n} images.
cm.adm.colorsHint: Each colour can have its own images — choosing a colour switches the gallery to them.
cm.adm.shipHint: Shipping and returns: if empty, the buyer sees that the club will state the terms when replying to the order.
cm.adm.buyingHint: External “Buy” link (Shopify product, Printful store or Stripe Payment Link). Empty — the “Request order” button opens an e-mail to wolvesmc@inbox.lv. No card data is handled on this site.
cm.adm.framesHint: Only if you have real 360° frames: at least 8 (24–36 recommended) evenly lit images taken while rotating the product evenly. Without frames, no 360° view is shown. Upload limit: 30 files per 10 minutes.
cm.adm.framesMin: A 360° view needs at least 8 frames (or remove them all).
cm.adm.deleteText: Delete “{name}”? This cannot be undone. To just hide it, use the “Archived” status.
cm.adm.noImgText: A published product without an image will look unfinished. Publish anyway?
cm.adm.partnersText: Partners and sponsors. A partner can be published only after their consent to use their brand and logo has been recorded.
cm.adm.needConsent: Record the partner's consent to use their brand and logo before publishing.
cm.adm.needConsentNote: Describe how the consent was given (who, when, how).
cm.adm.unpublishedNoConsent: Consent withdrawn — the partner is no longer shown.
cm.adm.consentTitle: Consent to use brand and logo
cm.adm.consentCheck: The partner has agreed that WBMC publishes its name, brand and logo.
cm.adm.consentPh: E.g.: e-mail from the partner's manager, 2026-11-02; agreement no. …
cm.adm.consentHint: Withdrawing consent removes the partner from the public page automatically. All changes are written to the audit log.
cm.adm.adsText: Ad placements. Only active or scheduled ads within their period are public (no more than 2 per placement), always labelled. Packages and prices are approved by the club separately.
cm.adm.adTitleHint: Used as the image's alternative text.
cm.adm.adStatusHint: “Active” and “Scheduled” are visible only between the start and end date.
cm.adm.label: Label
cm.adm.adRules: Ads are always shown with a label and a link with rel="sponsored".
cm.adm.needDates: An active or scheduled ad needs a start and end date.
cm.adm.badDates: The end date cannot be before the start date.
cm.adm.supportText: Bank details on the public “Support” page. They come from the specification draft and must be checked against the association's and bank's documents. “Bank details verified: <date>” appears on the page only after you mark them here.
cm.adm.bankSource: The details are stored in the site file assets/js/data.js (DONATE). If the IBAN changes, verification must be repeated.
cm.adm.notVerifiedText: The details are shown on the public page, but without the verified mark.
cm.adm.verifyStale: IBAN changed after verification — verify again
cm.adm.verifyIntro: Mark only after IBAN {iban}, the recipient and the bank have been compared with the association's and bank's documents.
cm.adm.verifyPh: E.g.: bank account confirmation letter, 2026-11-10; checked by a board member
cm.adm.unverifyText: The public page will no longer show “Bank details verified”.
